policy: All active report groups are required. No missing capture or skipped test passes. Covered means only the listed cases; all broad feature gates remain open. Exceptions use whole-image corrected expectations, never masks.

groups.limits: Synthetic operations; not every flag/zoom/remap combination or full UI.
Actual SDL versus Vulkan targets on local device; uniform light fixture does not prove spatial lighting.
All palette indices and opaque window alpha; not main UI.
Independent auxiliary views, no actual main UI or native terrain admission. Eight transparent views separately corroborated against frozen CLI.
Live versus published X8 output isolates shared defect; not Vulkan final UI evidence.

Synthetic immutable post-raster TTFSurface coverage, six thresholds, outlines/inset, nested clips, ordering and cache identity replacement/hit. Frozen bitmap API requires zoom0. Host font selection, shaping, TTF library rasterization and zoomed text layout remain unqualified.

Resolved spatial commands and all falloffs against CPU light rasterizer through actual SDL output; GPU commands contain no CPU intensity fallback. Does not qualify world source discovery, occlusion or temporal palette/light adaptation.
Real graphics-only shared executor with explicit initial contents/alpha and immutable sprite payload. No caller migration, retained world/LightFX, giant tiling or device-free packaging claim.
